puavo.audio.pipewire.default.description: Default priorities for both inputs and outputs, and is ignored if specific input or output setting is set

puavo.audio.pipewire.force_default.description: If set to true, ignore user configurations when considering device defaults

puavo.audio.pipewire.sink.default.description: Set Pipewire output default priorities, whitespace-separated list of device[:priority]

puavo.audio.pipewire.source.default.description: Set Pipewire input default priorities, whitespace-separated list of device[:priority]

puavo.audio.pipewire.sink.volume.description: Set Pipewire output volume priorities, whitespace-separated list of device[:volume], can also use plain volume to match all sinks

puavo.audio.pipewire.source.volume.description: Set Pipewire input volume priorities, whitespace-separated list of device[:volume], can also use plain volume to match all source

puavo.audio.pipewire.volume.description: Default volume for devices, whitespace-separated list of device[:volume], can also use plain volume to match all devices
